data.action: 抱抱枕蜷缩在沙发上安稳沉睡
data.description: 【羽毛笔 · 休息室午憩】罗德岛干员休息室柔软的大沙发上，拉菲艾拉整个人蜷缩成一团，怀里紧紧抱着一只毛绒大抱枕安稳沉睡，头顶的羽毛随着均匀的呼吸轻轻起伏。宛如一只在安全巢穴里熟睡的幼鸟，让人忍不住想要轻抚她的头顶。
data.lighting: warm golden window sunlight, soft dust motes, gentle ambient fill
data.promptProse: La Pluma sleeps curled around the fluffy cushion on the lounge sofa, her hair feather resting above it. A soft patch of window sunlight reaches her closed eyelids and the folds of her oversized sleeves.
data.title: 羽毛笔 · 休息室午憩
